name: semantic-layer
description: Local-first semantic tracing SDK for TypeScript and Python agent systems

scripts.lint: pnpm exec eslint . && uv run --project packages/python --extra dev ruff check packages/python
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' --if-present run typecheck && pnpm --filter semantic-layer-capture run typecheck:tests && uv run --isolated --project packages/python --extra dev mypy --config-file packages/python/pyproject.toml packages/python/semantic_layer
scripts.contracts:check: node contracts/trace/v1/validate-examples.mjs && node contracts/trace/v2/validate-contract.mjs && node scripts/cloud-integration.mjs contracts && pnpm --filter semantic-layer-capture run contracts:check && uv run --project packages/python --extra dev python packages/python/scripts/generate_capture_v1_models.py --check
scripts.build: pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' build && uv run --project packages/python --extra dev python -m build packages/python
scripts.verify: pnpm contracts:check && pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test:all && pnpm test:e2e:local && pnpm test:packages
